BACnet Scanner

Idle
⬡ BACnet Scanner: broadcasts a Who-Is on UDP 47808, collects every I-Am, reads each device's identity (name, vendor, model, firmware, object count), discovers routers / remote networks, and lets you drill into any device's object list. Compares everything against an imported BACnet Device Register. Run with or without a register.
